ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
The neper Python package runs the modules of Neper, a software package
for polycrystal generation and meshing, as Python functions, whose
arguments are the modules' command-line options.  It reads Neper's
files (tessellations, meshes, simulation directories) into NumPy
arrays, passes arrays to Neper as data files, and provides the
orientation functions of Neper's orilib program.
about.summary: Python interface to Neper, polycrystal generation and meshing

name: neper-python
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "7.0.1"

package:
  name: neper-python
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  # the Python package is in python/ of Neper's source tree, released with Neper
  url: https://github.com/neperfepx/neper/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: af52494ea343df596f99303a8ebf1f2aef8acf63c00b2c7c90afccdcb7e80807

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install ./python -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=61
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy
    # the package runs the neper and orilib programs
    - neper >=${{ version }}
    # neper (the program) is built for Linux and macOS only
    - __unix

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - neper
        - neper.orilib
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      pip_check: true

about:
  homepage: https://neper.info
  repository: https://github.com/neperfepx/neper
  documentation: https://neper.info/doc
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: Python interface to Neper, polycrystal generation and meshing
  description: |
    The neper Python package runs the modules of Neper, a software package
    for polycrystal generation and meshing, as Python functions, whose
    arguments are the modules' command-line options.  It reads Neper's
    files (tessellations, meshes, simulation directories) into NumPy
    arrays, passes arrays to Neper as data files, and provides the
    orientation functions of Neper's orilib program.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rquey
